model.name: R19.65: Generalize SVG viewer into a generic previewer for SVG, images, and href/HTML links.
model.description: The existing SVG fullscreen viewer (R18.34) MUST be generalized into a generic content previewer component that handles multiple content types: SVG (existing behavior), images (png/jpg/gif/webp), and href/HTML links (iframe). The component dispatches by content type to the appropriate renderer. This is the Object.verb pattern: ContentPreviewer.render(unit) where the unit's contentType determines the render strategy. Extensible for future types (pdf, video, etc.).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "maybe repurpose the existing svg viewer to make it generic — preview images AND href links too."
model.crossRefNote: R19.63 (preview in detail drawer) is where the previewer renders. R19.64 (per-type rules) defines what each type looks like. R19.65 is the COMPONENT itself — the generalized viewer.
